将静止图像变成电影剪辑

在 Floyo 上打开这个可立即运行的工作流程。无需安装。

它是如何运作的

步骤 1. 上传您的参考图片。剪辑开始的图像。清晰的主题和电影般的框架效果最好。适用于：人物艺术·风景·产品镜头·概念框架

步骤 2. 描述镜头。说出发生了什么以及相机如何移动。短而具体的节拍长而模糊，就像“一只狗跑过森林的电影镜头”。

步骤 3. 启用第二个参考（可选）。默认情况下，第二个图像加载器处于静音状态。打开它并上传混合或合成镜头的第二个参考。

步骤 4. 点击运行并下载。该模型渲染 81 帧并以 16fps 保存 5 秒的 MP4。在工作流程中预览，然后下载。准备就绪：首映·DaVinci Resolve·CapCut·After Effects

第一次？将所有设置保留原样。默认值（1280 x 720 · 81 帧 · 10 个步骤 · 指导 2 · 固定种子）对于几乎每个人来说都是正确的起点。

概述

此工作流程使用 Wan 2.1 FusionX 将静止图像动画化为电影剪辑，Wan 2.1 FusionX 是由 Vrgamedevgirl84 对阿里巴巴的 Wan 2.1 14B 图像到视频模型进行的社区微调。它是基础 Wan 2.1，融合了多个研究模型，包括 CausVid、AccVideo 和 MoviiGen，可提高运动质量、场景一致性和细节。这种合并具有电影的偏见，因此它倾向于戏剧性的镜头移动和开箱即用的喜怒无常的灯光。它还针对速度进行了调整，可支持 6 到 10 步，比基础 Wan 2.1 快 50%，这使得它非常适合迭代镜头。您上传一张图像，描述镜头，然后在大约 2 分 38 秒内获得一个 5 秒的剪辑。无需设置，无需连接节点。

适用人群：希望在 ComfyUI 中实现电影图像到视频的电影制作人、概念艺术家和社交创作者，而无需从头开始连接 Wan 节点。不适合：可读的框架内文本或复杂的多字符编排。这是针对单个清晰主题和定义的相机移动进行调整的重型渲染。

为什么选择弗洛约

Floyo 是浏览器中唯一为团队构建的 ComfyUI 平台。

  • 专为团队打造。在整个团队中共享运行历史记录、文件和模型。队友会打开您的确切路线并从您上次停下的地方继续。没有文件交接，没有版本混乱。

  • 无需安装，无需设置。每个工作流程和模型均已预加载。在浏览器中打开它并运行。无需下载，无需配置。

  • 没有本地硬件。工作流程在 H100 NVL GPU 上运行，因此重型模型无需您自己的卡即可快速运行。您的 VRAM 不再是限制。

  • 在一处打开和关闭模型。Floyo 同时运行开源工作流程和 API 模型。

如何使用（在 Floyo 上的浏览器中）

  1. 上传您的参考图片。

  2. 描述镜头和摄像机移动，如果需要混合，则启用第二个参考，然后运行。

  3. 下载 5 秒剪辑，适合任何剪辑师。

期望模型已预加载，因此无需下载任何内容。运行它需要一个免费的 Floyo 帐户。每个片段大约需要2分38秒。有几件事决定了结果。保持提示简短且具有电影感，命名相机移动、灯光和情绪，因为长提示会使模型超载。如果运动看起来很紧张，请将指导降低到 1。如果剪辑忽略了您的提示，请一次将其提高一个点。保持在 720p 训练范围附近，因为更大的训练范围会花费时间和内存，而且无法保证质量增益。关于许可：基础 Wan 2.1 是 Apache 2.0，但 FusionX 合并了非商业许可下的组件，例如 CausVid 的 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，因此创建者声明不允许商业使用。在使用输出之前自行进行尽职调查 商业上。

使用案例

电影镜头。将概念艺术或剧照转化为具有戏剧性镜头移动、体积照明和喜怒无常的氛围的剪辑。

概念与预览。在进行完整的生产过程之前测试框架如何移动，以 10 个步骤足够快地进行迭代。

双参考合成。将两张参考图像混合到一个剪辑中，以进行环境中的角色拍摄或风格转换。

社交和投资组合。将静态图片变成精美的短片，用于 Reels、TikTok 或创意作品集。

Wan 2.1 FusionX 可以制作什么动画？

o.en:
Turn a still into a cinematic clip

Open this ready-to-run workflow on Floyo. No install needed.

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1. Upload your reference image. The image the clip starts from. A clear subject with cinematic framing works best. Works great with: character art · landscapes · product shots · concept frames

Step 2. Describe the shot. Say what happens and how the camera moves. Short and specific beats long and vague, like "cinematic shot of a dog running through a forest."

Step 3. Enable a second reference (optional). A second image loader sits muted by default. Turn it on and upload a second reference for blended or composite shots.

Step 4. Hit run and download. The model renders 81 frames and saves a 5-second MP4 at 16fps. Preview it in the workflow, then download. Ready for: Premiere · DaVinci Resolve · CapCut · After Effects

First time? Leave every setting as-is. The defaults (1280 x 720 · 81 frames · 10 steps · guidance 2 · fixed seed) are the right starting point for almost everyone.

Overview

This workflow animates a still into a cinematic clip using Wan 2.1 FusionX, a community fine-tune of Alibaba's Wan 2.1 14B image-to-video model by Vrgamedevgirl84. It is the base Wan 2.1 merged with several research models, including CausVid, AccVideo, and MoviiGen, which push motion quality, scene consistency, and detail. The merge has a cinematic bias, so it leans toward dramatic camera moves and moody lighting out of the box. It is also tuned for speed and holds up at 6 to 10 steps, up to 50% faster than base Wan 2.1, which makes it good for iterating on a shot. You upload an image, describe the shot, and get a 5-second clip back in about 2 minutes 38 seconds. No setup, no nodes to wire.

Who it's for: filmmakers, concept artists, and social creators who want cinematic image-to-video in ComfyUI without wiring the Wan nodes from scratch. Not for: readable in-frame text or complex multi-character choreography. It is a heavy render tuned for a single clear subject and a defined camera move.

Why Floyo

Floyo is the only ComfyUI platform built for teams in the browser.

  • Made for teams.Share run history, files, and models across your whole team. A teammate opens your exact run and picks up where you left off. No file handoffs, no version confusion.

  • No install, no setup.Every workflow and model is preloaded. Open it in your browser and run. Nothing to download, nothing to configure.

  • No local hardware.Workflows run on H100 NVL GPUs, so heavy models run fast without a card of your own. Your VRAM stops being the limit.

  • Open and closed models in one place.Floyo runs open-source workflows and API models side by side.

How to use (in your browser on Floyo)

  1. Upload your reference image.

  2. Describe the shot and the camera move, enable a second reference if you want a blend, then run.

  3. Download the 5-second clip, ready for any editor.

ExpectationsThe models are preloaded, so there is nothing to download. Running it needs a free Floyo account. Each clip takes about 2 minutes 38 seconds. A few things decide the result. Keep prompts short and cinematic, naming the camera move, the lighting, and the mood, since long prompts overload the model. If motion looks jittery, lower guidance toward 1. If the clip ignores your prompt, raise it a point at a time. Stay near the 720p training range, since going larger costs time and memory without a guaranteed quality gain. On licensing: base Wan 2.1 is Apache 2.0, but FusionX merges components under non-commercial licenses like CausVid's CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so the creator states commercial use is not permitted. Do your own due diligence before using output commercially.

Use Cases

Cinematic Shots. Turn concept art or stills into clips with dramatic camera moves, volumetric lighting, and moody atmospherics.

Concept & Previz. Test how a frame moves before committing to a full production pass, fast enough at 10 steps to iterate.

Dual-Reference Compositing. Blend two reference images into one clip for character-in-environment shots or style transfers.

Social & Portfolio. Turn one still into a short, polished clip for Reels, TikTok, or a creative portfolio.
